heading: Lakehaven, Washington, Water Reclamation and Reuse Project

tree.heading: Authorization
tree.text: The Secretary, in cooperation with the Lakehaven Utility District, Washington, is authorized to participate in the design, planning, and construction of, and land acquisition for, a project to reclaim and reuse wastewater, including degraded groundwaters, within and outside of the service area of the Lakehaven Utility District.

tree.heading: Cost share
tree.text: The Federal share of the cost of the project authorized by this section shall not exceed 25 percent of the total cost of the project.

tree.heading: Limitation
tree.text: The Secretary shall not provide funds for the operation and maintenance of the project authorized by this section.
